title: When Action Research Becomes a Crutch: Dependency, Shared Reflexivity and Scholar Activism in Community Supported Agricul-Ture
why: A four-year participatory action research project that turns its critical lens on itself: research dependency became a crutch for the community it was meant to serve. Read this before you promise participation again.
caveat: One Italian community-supported agriculture initiative over four years. The dependency pattern may belong to that funding and governance arrangement.
source: Crossref topic: Participatory action research, Journal watch: Action Research
